# Spreadsheets That Do the Hard Part — Excel & Google Sheets

> Working Excel and Google Sheets workbooks for jobs where the arithmetic is easy to get wrong: WIP schedules, bid pricing, landed cost, SPC and more.

## Construction and contracting

- [Construction WIP schedule](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/construction-wip-schedule/): Percentage of completion with the loss rule most templates get wrong, plus fade analysis, income-statement tie-out and bonding ratios. $119, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/construction-wip-schedule-template
- [Electrical estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/electrical-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for electrical work, with a 40-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/electrical-estimating-template
- [HVAC estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/hvac-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for HVAC work, with a 39-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/hvac-estimating-template
- [Roofing estimating template](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/roofing-estimating-template/): Burdened labour rate, overhead recovery and margin-not-markup pricing for roofing work, with a 37-item price book and job costing. $89, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/roofing-estimating-template

- [Progress billing and schedule of values](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/progress-billing-schedule-of-values/): Payment applications with retainage taken net of prior retainage, stored materials kept separate, and six checks before you submit. $89, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/progress-billing-schedule-of-values
- [Construction cash flow forecast](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/construction-cash-flow-forecast/): S-curve revenue, split collection lags, retainage release and a line of credit — to find the month you run out of money. $99, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. - [Equipment cost per hour](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/equipment-cost-per-hour/): What each machine costs per hour owned versus rented, the break-even hours, and which machines you should not own at all. $89, 9 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/equipment-cost-per-hour-calculator
- [Certified payroll and Davis-Bacon fringe](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/certified-payroll-davis-bacon/): Annualises the fringe credit over total annual hours, not Davis-Bacon hours — the error that creates back-wage liability. $89, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/certified-payroll-davis-bacon-fringe-calculator

## Manufacturing and quality

- [SPC control charts and process capability](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/spc-control-chart-cpk-workbook/): Xbar-R, I-MR and p-charts with Western Electric rules, Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk, and a full AIAG Gage R&R study. $79, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/spc-control-chart-cpk-workbook
- [Design of experiments](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/design-of-experiments-excel/): A full 2^4 factorial with effects, ANOVA, a normal plot, Lenth's method and a curvature test from centre points. $69, 7 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/design-of-experiments-excel
- [Monte Carlo simulation](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/monte-carlo-simulation-excel/): A working simulation engine in native formulas — 12 variables, 1,000 trials, five distributions and correlated inputs. No add-in. $69, 8 tabs, Excel and Google Sheets. Buy: https://thecalmdeskco.gumroad.com/l/monte-carlo-simulation-excel

## When Excel changes your data

- [Leading zeros disappear](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-leading-zeros-disappear/): Why 01234 becomes 1234, and the one import setting that keeps the zero. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Accents turn into mojibake](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-csv-utf8-mojibake/): Ni&Atilde;&plusmn;al instead of Ni&ntilde;al. One import setting fixes it, and one export setting stops it. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Text silently becomes a date](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-converts-text-to-dates/): SEP1, 1-2 and 3/4 all convert on entry. Why it is irreversible, and how to prevent it. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [#N/A when the value is clearly there](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-vlookup-non-breaking-space/): Invisible spaces break exact matches. Why TRIM alone is not enough. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Everything landed in column A](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-csv-all-in-column-a/): Comma vs semicolon is a regional setting. Fix it on import, not in Windows. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [SUM ignores numbers that look fine](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-numbers-stored-as-text/): Text that looks numeric is skipped by SUM, AVERAGE and every other calculation. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Barcodes become 1.23E+14](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-scientific-notation-barcodes/): Scientific notation is cosmetic. The 15-digit limit behind it is not. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.

## Formulas that do not behave as they read

- [The $ sign, and why dragging breaks formulas](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-absolute-relative-references/): What $ actually locks, the four forms, and when each one is correct. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Formulas showing stale results](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-formulas-not-updating/): Calculation set to Manual is the usual cause. Five checks, in order. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Getting unique values from a column](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-unique-values-list/): UNIQUE if you have it, and three methods that work on any version. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [What is in list A but not list B](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-compare-two-lists/): COUNTIF on any version, FILTER on 365, and why matches fail. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Group by and sum](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-sumifs-vs-pivot-table/): SUMIFS for a live figure in a fixed report; a pivot table for exploring. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Joining two sheets on a key](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-join-two-sheets-lookup/): XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH and VLOOKUP compared, and why VLOOKUP breaks. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Totalling filtered rows](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-sum-visible-rows-only/): SUM ignores filters. SUBTOTAL and AGGREGATE do not — and they differ. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Empty-looking cells that are not empty](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-return-blank-not-zero/): Why "" is not blank, what it breaks, and what to do instead. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Which COUNT function to use](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-count-functions-explained/): What each one includes, and why the gaps between them are diagnostic. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Why =-3^2 returns 9](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-negative-number-squared/): Excel binds the unary minus before the exponent. Where that quietly breaks results. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [Filling a formula down a whole column](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/excel-apply-formula-entire-column/): Double-click, Ctrl+D, a table, or a spill formula. When each one fails. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.

## Cleaning a real export

- [A bank statement export](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/clean-bank-statement-export-excel/): Amounts as text, negatives in brackets, dates in the wrong locale. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [A student or class list export](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/clean-student-list-excel/): Student IDs lose their zeros; names arrive in inconsistent shapes. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [An inventory or SKU export](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/clean-inventory-sku-export-excel/): SKUs, barcodes and date-shaped codes — three failures in one file. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [A CRM or contact export](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/clean-crm-contact-export-excel/): Web-pasted invisible characters, phone formats, and duplicates that will not dedupe. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
- [A payroll or timesheet export](https://www.allanninal.dev/spreadsheets/clean-payroll-timesheet-export-excel/): Mixed hour formats, totals resetting past 24 hours, and lost employee IDs. Free guide, no signup. Includes a free Excel workbook.
